facts.fact: EO Handbook 2026 reports that by 2025 Zimbabwean technicians at ZCHPC operated Sen4Stat to produce national crop type maps and maize acreage estimates for the agriculture ministry and ZIMSTAT, and a field-level drought monitoring tool was automated in 2025.
